short_description:
Where to find the Skunk Ape, GTA 6's Bigfoot: the lakeside road at Cottonmouth Lake, south of Hamlet in Grassrivers. Look for a deer carcass; it's available early in Chapter 1, and night is best. Kirk's 'Mr. Mangrove' side quests (flyer at Skeeter's bar in Hamlet) take it further. Guides also name Gullet Marsh. No story spoilers. Every spot is pinned on our interactive map at vicereplay.com (Guides → GTA 6 Map).

📍 Map Spot #5 of our GTA 6 map series: every spot is in the playlist "GTA 6 Map: Where to Find It".

Map: Rockstar Games' official Leonida map. Sources: GTABase, GamesRadar, Dexerto, Game8, VICE.
